meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目里没人调用的代码安全删掉,并留下可回退的提交记录。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目里堆积了越来越多没人再调用的旧代码,想干净利落地清掉。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if old unused code keeps piling up in your project and you want it gone safely.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描项目里没被引用的代码,用 LSP 引用检查逐个确认,再分批发给并行子代理删除,并做原子提交,最后跑类型检查、测试和构建验收。产出删除清单与验证汇总表。
howto.when: 当你说出「remove dead code」「dead code」「cleanup」等关键词,或要求清理未使用的代码时触发;给出文件路径、目录或符号名可缩小扫描范围。

say.text: 帮我移除项目里没被引用的死代码
say.note: 先扫描并用 LSP 验证,再派代理删除

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录下的死代码
找一下 src/foo.ts 里没被引用的导出符号

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans the project for unreferenced code, confirms each candidate with LSP reference checks, then sends removals to parallel sub-agents that edit and commit atomically, followed by typecheck, test and build verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "remove dead code", "dead code" or "cleanup", or ask to clean up unused code; a file path, directory or symbol name narrows the scan.

say_en.text: Remove the dead code that nothing in this project references
Only clean up dead code under src/utils
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to one directory
Limits the scan to one file
